title: Return a sharp task interval instead of inventing an unmeasured constitutive law
statement: Let A=L-m, l_i=y_i-r_i-m*x_i and u_i=y_i+r_i-m*x_i, anchored x0=0,l0=u0=0. L_data(x)=max_i[l_i-A*max(x_i-x,0)], U_data(x)=min_i[u_i+A*max(x-x_i,0)]. Feasibility is L_data(x_i)<=u_i for all i. At b>=a, f(b) lies sharply in[m*b+max l_i, m*b+min_i(u_i+A*(b-x_i))] in the closed class.

requires: Known derivative bounds, scalar independent calibrated Gaussian noise, safe query interval and target displacement. Endpoint dominance is for the explicit known monotone-gap pair, not every analytic family. Analytic sharpness requires a strictly feasible witness for every non-anchor interval.
provides: Let A=L-m, l_i=y_i-r_i-m*x_i and u_i=y_i+r_i-m*x_i, anchored x0=0,l0=u0=0. L_data(x)=max_i[l_i-A*max(x_i-x,0)], U_data(x)=min_i[u_i+A*max(x-x_i,0)]. Feasibility is L_data(x_i)<=u_i for all i. At b>=a, f(b) lies sharply in[m*b+max l_i, m*b+min_i(u_i+A*(b-x_i))] in the closed class.
assumptions: Real analyticity alone is not a uniform complex strip/norm prior. Exact noiseless analytic rigidity is exceptional; it cannot justify stable finite-error recovery. Sequential expected counts differ from hard budgets. Closed-class target intervals retain width at least(L-m)(b-a); equality at a nonattained analytic endpoint needs separate attainment analysis. SAFE means only f(b)<=ceiling, not general physical safety or permission to interrogate b. Per-record99% coverage is not simultaneous campaign coverage. No acquired measurement, fabricated device, historical priority, efficient algorithm or practical advantage is inferred from these mathematical/model results. Mission NOT_ACHIEVED.
costs: Pay force readings, sigma, all stopping samples, sensor channels and any network gain/material count/inverse stability margin. Existing SPRT and optimal-recovery/LP methods supply strong conventional incumbents, not new instruments. A quantitative transition-width/complex-domain prior must be acquired independently.
contract.units: One declared force/displacement normalization; m,L force per displacement; sigma force noise; n,N scalar reading counts. SAFE is a mathematical force predicate.
contract.obstruction: Acquire a supported transition-sensitive channel, target-regime interrogation or justified quantitative prior for decisions still UNKNOWN. Do not replace missing physical information by fitted smoothness.

body: The max/min asymmetric cones preserve monotonicity and common Lipschitz bound and are themselves feasible extremizers. With strictly positive non-anchor data slack, mix an envelope with a strict witness, Gaussian-smooth the finite hinge representation, then re-anchor; this approaches each endpoint with analytic bounded-derivative laws. Without slack, exact data f(a)=m*a force global analytic linearity and invalidate blanket closed-class sharpness. Certify the ceiling only if the upper endpoint<=T, reject if the lower>T, otherwise UNKNOWN. The rule gives a task premise, not the actual material law or permission for a new experiment.
